title: server-labels.json
description: The server label dictionary in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations: the labels the naming rules give servers, such as EXG's 装备 and 热门, with the community's word and the words by language. The site takes a merged version only when every file passes this schema and the checks it cannot express: an ID given twice, blank words.

id.description: The label's ID, which the naming rules give

names.description: The label's word by language: en, zh-CN, ja, ko. A language left out shows the community's word, never another language's; zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN

word.description: The community's own word for the label, e.g. 装备; a language names leaves out shows it

labels.description: The server labels the naming rules give
